description:
1. The agent must generate a pre-meeting brief FILE in the meetings/YYYY-MM/ subdirectory named YYYY-MM-DD-[paxo-or-discovery-slug].md. The brief must include a Discovery Objectives section, a BANT Quick-Capture section (Budget/Authority/Need/Timeline fields), and a Qualification Signal section — these are discovery-call-specific sections defined only in the skill.
2. The agent must produce structured meeting notes (either in the same file or a separate file in meetings/YYYY-MM/) with Key Decisions and a properly formatted 5-column action items table: # | Action | Owner | Due | Priority.
3. The meeting notes file must follow the exact naming convention YYYY-MM-DD-[meeting-slug].md and be placed inside meetings/YYYY-MM/ (not flat in meetings/), as specified by the skill.
4. meetings/meeting-log.md must be updated with a new row for the Paxo discovery meeting using the exact column schema: Date | Meeting | Type | Key Decision | File.
5. meetings/open-actions.md must be updated: the pre-existing 'Send revised invoice' row must be preserved (not deleted), new rows for the two action items (proposal and brand assets) must be added, the schema must include the Meeting column (# | Action | Owner | Due | Meeting | Status — a bespoke 6-column schema unique to this skill), and the Meeting column must reference the source meeting's .md filename. An agent relying on generic knowledge will omit the Meeting column, use wrong headers, fail the BANT/Discovery Objectives/Qualification sections, or put the file in the wrong directory.
